title: READ-003: Add JSDoc to public API functions
description: Public API functions lack JSDoc documentation. Developers using this module won't know what parameters mean, what the function returns, what exceptions can be thrown, or what the API contract is. Adding comprehensive JSDoc improves IDE support and code discoverability.

context.goal: Add JSDoc @param, @returns, @throws documentation to all public functions

acceptance_criteria: All 8 public API functions have complete JSDoc blocks
Each JSDoc includes @param tags for all parameters
Each JSDoc includes @returns tag describing return type
@param descriptions are clear and specific (e.g., 'Page number (1-indexed)')
IDE autocomplete shows documentation when hovering over function calls
No typos or grammatical errors in documentation

implementation_notes.jsdoc_template:
/**
 * Brief description of what function does
 * @param {type} paramName - Description of parameter
 * @returns {Promise<Type>} Description of return value
 */

functions_to_document.name: createUser
functions_to_document.returns: Promise<{id: string, username: string, role: string}>

implementation_notes.example_jsdoc:
/**
 * Fetch paginated list of users
 * @param {number} page - Page number (1-indexed)
 * @param {number} limit - Records per page
 * @returns {Promise<{data: User[], total: number}>} Paginated user list
 */

code_review: Verify all 8 functions have JSDoc blocks
Check each JSDoc has @param tags for all parameters
Verify no typos or grammatical errors
ide_test: Open VSCode and hover over getUsers() to see JSDoc tooltip
Verify autocomplete suggestions show parameter documentation
Check type hints show correct types (string, number, Promise, etc.)
formatting_test: Check alignment and indentation are correct

rollback_plan: git revert <commit-hash> — documentation-only change, safe to revert
notes: This is documentation work that improves developer experience without changing functionality. JSDoc should follow TSDoc standard for TypeScript projects. Consider IDE setup for best results (VSCode with TypeScript extension).
